output.rationale: The requirement specifies tension-control, high-strength bolt-nut-washer assemblies for metal-clad switchgear. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the specification. This product is engineered-to-order (ETO), suitable for the detailed requirements of the Syracuse Airport Specification.
